title: Government's Obligation to Lay a Copy of the Annual Report before Each House of Parliament

content.scenario: The Central Consumer Protection Authority has submitted its annual report to the Government of India. The Government must now decide what to do with the report.
content.outcome: The Government must lay a copy of the annual report before each House of Parliament as soon as may be after it is received.

user_queries: What happens to the annual report submitted by the Central Consumer Protection Authority?
Is the Government required to lay the annual report before Parliament?
